item.title: [data-breach] Robotic surgery firm Intuitive reports data breach after targeted phishing attack
item.description: Intuitive suffered a phishing attack leading to a data breach exposing customer, employee, and corporate information. Intuitive is an American company that designs, manufactures, and sells robotic systems for minimally invasive surgery.
